name: Bring a reusable bottle
detail: One refill a day keeps 365 plastic bottles out of the sea.

name: Bring a reusable shopping bag
detail: A bag used twice a week replaces about 100 plastic ones a year.

name: Refuse single-use cutlery/straw
detail: Plastic forks are used for minutes and stay for centuries.

name: Bring your own food container
detail: Your own container means no foam box heading to landfill.

name: Finish your food
detail: A third of all food grown is never eaten. This plate was.

name: Buy local products
detail: Food that travelled less arrives fresher and lighter on fuel.

name: Eat a plant-based meal
detail: One plant-based meal saves roughly the water of a long shower.

name: Buy secondhand
detail: Buying it used means nothing new had to be made.

name: Turn off tap while brushing
detail: A running tap wastes six litres a minute you never use.

name: Shorter shower (< 5 min)
detail: Two minutes less is about twenty litres saved, every time.

name: Reuse washing water for plants
detail: Your plants cannot tell the difference. The reservoir can.

name: Wash full loads only
detail: A half-empty machine uses the same water as a full one.

name: Collect rainwater
detail: Free water, already delivered to your roof.

name: Fix a leaking tap
detail: A slow drip loses a full bathtub in a month.

name: Refuse plastic bag
detail: Refused once is better than recycled twice.

name: Choose digital receipt
detail: Receipt paper is coated, so it cannot be recycled at all.

name: Segregate organic/inorganic waste
detail: Sorted waste gets recycled. Mixed waste rarely does.

name: Compost food scraps
detail: Food scraps in landfill make methane. In soil they make soil.

name: Refill household product
detail: The bottle you already own works just as well the second time.

name: Repair instead of replacing
detail: A repair costs one evening. A replacement costs a whole new thing.

name: Drop off waste at bank sampah
detail: Sorted and dropped off, it becomes material again, not litter.

name: Turn off unused lights
detail: An empty room lit all evening is a bill for nothing.

name: Unplug idle chargers
detail: A charger left in draws power all day for no phone at all.

name: Turn off monitor when away
detail: A screen nobody is looking at still burns the same watts.

name: Wash clothes with cold water
detail: Nine tenths of a wash's energy goes into heating the water.

name: Air-dry clothes
detail: Sun and air do it for free, and clothes last longer for it.

name: Set AC to 24°C or above
detail: Every degree cooler costs several percent more power.

name: Combine errands into one trip
detail: A cold engine pollutes most. One trip starts it once.

name: Walk instead of riding
detail: Under two kilometres, walking is usually the faster door to door.

name: Carpool / ride-share
detail: Four people, one engine, a quarter of the emissions each.

name: Skip commute (WFH)
detail: The greenest commute is the one that does not happen.

name: Take public transport
detail: One full bus takes forty cars off the road.

name: Cycle instead of motor vehicle
detail: No fuel, no fumes, no parking. Just you.

name: Complete in-app learning card
detail: Knowing why makes the habit stick after the novelty goes.

name: Share your progress
detail: People copy what they see their friends doing.

name: Educate someone about local issue
detail: One conversation can change more than one person's habits.

name: Regional daily mission
detail: What matters most depends on where you are standing.

name: Visit refill station / bank sampah
detail: Refilling is the cheapest way to buy nothing new.
